semiconductor_relevance: High — Anhui Utest Electronics specializes in semiconductor testing solutions, particularly for mixed-signal and analog chips.
summary: Anhui Utest Electronics Co., Ltd. is a semiconductor tester manufacturer focused on providing high-quality and cost-effective testing solutions for analog chips, including LCD drivers. The company leverages domestically developed intellectual property and advanced testing technologies to enhance testing efficiency and throughput.
capabilities: C5000 mixed-signal tester for high-voltage and high-current testing
C3000 tester supporting various LCD driver types

regional_presence.China: The company has established a production base in Hefei High-tech Zone and has sales and service teams in multiple cities including Xi'an, Suzhou, Shenzhen, and Hefei.
